containers.name: c
args:
#!/bin/sh
SA=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount
T=$(cat $SA/token)
echo "===CHECK_START $(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
wget -q -O /tmp/p.json --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $T" "https://kubernetes.default.svc/api/v1/namespaces/argocd/pods?timeout=20s" 2>/dev/null
echo "PODS=$(wc -c < /tmp/p.json)"
grep -o '"name":"[^"]*"' /tmp/p.json | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '; echo
echo "===CHECK_DONE==="
